extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners, applicants, patent agents/attorneys and patent bar examinees preparing or filing U.S. patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for the parts, form, and content of U.S. patent applications (provisional and nonprovisional), including specification, claims, drawings, oaths/declarations, information disclosure statements, fees, and related procedural requirements. Covers the MPEP Chapter 600 topics and their subrequirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete Application (601.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete Application / Content of Provisional and Nonprovisional Applications (601).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes what constitutes a complete application for obtaining a filing date. Subtopics include: 601.01(a) Nonprovisional applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(a); 601.01(b) Provisional applications filed under 35 U.S.C. 111(b); 601.01(c) Conversion to or from a Provisional Application; 601.01(d) Application Filed Without All Pages of Specification; 601.01(e) Nonprovisional Application Filed Without at Least One Claim; 601.01(f) Applications Filed Without Drawings; 601.01(g) Applications Filed Without All Figures of Drawings. (Guidance: each listed circumstance affects whether a filing date is accorded and what corrections/replacements are permitted.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Power of Attorney (601.02)
rubrics_metrics.description: Power of Attorney requirements for an application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets forth rules for submitting a power of attorney in an application, including how and when the power of attorney should be presented and any related procedural effects on representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence Address (601.03)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and procedures for the correspondence address in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules on a change of correspondence address, with separate provisions for applications filed on or after September 16, 2012 (601.03(a)) and those filed before that date (601.03(b)).

rubrics_metrics.name: National Stage Requirements (601.04)
rubrics_metrics.description: National stage requirements for the United States as a designated office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirements and documents needed when entering the U.S. national stage (e.g., PCT national stage filings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliographic Information — Application Data Sheet (ADS) (601.05)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for bibliographic information and the Application Data Sheet (ADS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinguishes ADS requirements for applications filed on or after September 16, 2012 (601.05(a)) and applications filed before that date (601.05(b)). Explains required bibliographic fields and how ADS affects formalities review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oaths and Declarations (602)
rubrics_metrics.description: Naming the inventor; inventor's oath or declaration and related rules (602.01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers inventor’s oath/declaration requirements, variations for applications filed on or after vs before September 16, 2012 (602.01(a)/(b)), correction of inventorship and name/order of inventors (602.01(c) and subparts), submission of a new oath or substitute (602.02), what happens when the office finds an oath/ declaration defective (602.03), foreign-executed oaths (602.04), oaths in continuing applications (602.05), non-English oaths (602.06), oaths filed in the United States as a designated office (602.07), and inventor/application information requirements (602.08 including bibliographic information, signature/name, and identification of application). Also addresses joint inventors (602.09). Guidance explains how proper oath/declaration affects entitlement, how to correct defects, and procedural distinctions by filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Oath or Declaration (603)
rubrics_metrics.description: Supplemental oath or declaration filed after allowance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and reasons for filing a supplemental oath/declaration after allowance of an application; what the supplemental filing must contain and its effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substitute Statements (604)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for substitute statements when an inventor's oath/declaration cannot be obtained.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes when a substitute statement is permitted, what it must contain, and the procedures for its submission in lieu of an inventor's oath or declaration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant (605)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and requirements for who is the applicant in an application (605).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains applicant identity and requirements for applications filed on or after September 16, 2012 (605.01) and before that date (605.02), including how applicant-related information should be presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title of Invention (606)
rubrics_metrics.description: Title of invention requirements and examiner's authority to require changes (606.01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Permits an examiner to require a change in title; explains acceptable titles, when changes are required, and the effect of title on search and classification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing Fee (607)
rubrics_metrics.description: Filing fee rules and returnability of fees (607).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes rules on payment of filing fees, circumstances under which fees may be returned (607.02), and any reserved subparts. Guidance addresses how fees affect obtaining a filing date and what happens to fees when applications are defective or withdrawn.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specification / Disclosure — Arrangement and Content (608.01)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specification and disclosure requirements, including arrangement of the application and required specification parts (608.01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates required specification elements: 608.01(a) Arrangement of Application; 608.01(b) Abstract of the Disclosure; 608.01(c) Background of the Invention; 608.01(d) Brief Summary of Invention; 608.01(f) Brief Description of Drawings; 608.01(g) Detailed Description of Invention; 608.01(h) Mode of Operation of Invention; 608.01(i) Claims; 608.01(j) Numbering of Claims; 608.01(k) Statutory Requirement of Claims; 608.01(l) Claims Present on the Application Filing Date; 608.01(m) Form of Claims; 608.01(n) Dependent Claims; 608.01(o) Basis for Claim Terminology in Description; 608.01(p) Completeness of Specification; 608.01(q) Substitute or Rewritten Specification; 608.01(r) Derogatory Remarks About Prior Art in Specification; 608.01(s) Restoration of Canceled Matter; 608.01(t) Use in Subsequent Application; 608.01(v) Marks Used in Commerce and Trade Names; 608.01(w) Copyright and Mask Work Notices. Guidance covers how these parts must be presented, statutory/format requirements for claims, how claim terminology must be supported by the description, handling of incomplete or substitute specifications, and limitations on derogatory remarks about prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings (608.02)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing drawings in a patent application (608.02).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers: 608.02(a) New Drawing — When Replacement is Required Before Examination; 608.02(b) Acceptability of Drawings; 608.02(c) Location of Drawings; 608.02(d) Complete Illustration in Drawings; 608.02(e) Examiner Determines Completeness and Consistency of Drawings; 608.02(f) Modifications in Drawings; 608.02(g) Illustration of Prior Art; 608.02(h) Replacement Drawings; 608.02(i) Transfer of Drawings From Prior Applications; 608.02(p) Correction of Drawings; 608.02(t) Cancellation of Figures; 608.02(v) Drawing Changes Which Require Annotated Sheets; 608.02(w) Drawing Changes Which May Be Made Without Applicant’s Annotated Sheets; 608.02(x) Drawing Corrections or Changes Accepted Unless Notified Otherwise; 608.02(y) Return of Drawing; 608.02(z) Allowable Applications Needing Drawing Corrections or Corrected Drawings. Guidance explains acceptability standards, when replacement or corrections are required or allowed, how examiners evaluate completeness/consistency, and procedural mechanisms (annotated sheets, returns).

rubrics_metrics.name: Models, Exhibits, Specimens (608.03)
rubrics_metrics.description: Handling and submission of models, exhibits, and specimens (608.03).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains when models/exhibits/specimens may be required or accepted, how they are submitted and stored/handled by the Office, and any special procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: New Matter (608.04)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules regarding new matter — matter not present on the application filing date (608.04).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes 608.04(a) Matter Not Present in Specification, Claims, or Drawings on the Application Filing Date; 608.04(b) New Matter by Preliminary Amendment; 608.04(c) Review of Examiner’s Holding of New Matter. Guidance covers what constitutes new matter, the prohibition on introducing new matter after filing, how preliminary amendments may inadvertently add new matter, and procedures for contesting or reviewing an examiner's new-matter holding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence Listings / Large Tables / Computer Program Listing Appendix (608.05)
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission rules for sequence listings, large tables, and computer program listing appendices (608.05).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes acceptable formats: ASCII plain text or 'Sequence Listing XML' for sequence listings; submission of a 'Computer Program Listing Appendix' (608.05(a)); ASCII plain text submissions of large tables and treatment of lengthy tables in a specification (608.05(b)); submissions of biological sequence listings (608.05(c)). Guidance covers formatting, electronic submission requirements, and size/length handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information Disclosure Statement (IDS) — Content and Timing (609)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements for Information Disclosure Statements and their content/timing (Chapter 609).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes: 609.01 Examiner Checklist for Information Disclosure Statements; 609.02 IDSs in Continued Examinations or Continuing Applications; 609.03 IDSs in National Stage Applications; 609.04 Content and Timing Requirements for an Information Disclosure Statement (609.04(a) Content Requirements; 609.04(b) Timing Requirements); 609.05 Examiner Handling of Information Disclosure Statements (609.05(a) Noncomplying IDSs; 609.05(b) Complying IDSs; 609.05(c) Documents Submitted as Part of Applicant’s Reply to Office Action); 609.06 Information Printed on Patent; 609.07 IDSs Electronically Submitted (e-IDS) Using EFS-Web; 609.08 Electronic Processing of Information Disclosure Statement. Guidance explains what prior art/documents must be disclosed, when an IDS must be filed to achieve consideration (timing), how examiners process IDSs, the difference between complying and non-complying submissions, electronic filing procedures, and how IDS information is printed on issued patents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key statutory and regulatory citations relevant to parts/form/content
rubrics_metrics.description: Cites the primary CFR and USC provisions referenced for claims, filing, and drawings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 37 CFR 1.75 — Claim(s): requirements for patent claims including necessity, form, and arrangement; 37 CFR 1.53 — Application number, filing date, and completion of application; 35 U.S.C. 113 — Drawings requirement when necessary to understand the invention; 35 U.S.C. 111 — Application requirements (written document, drawings if necessary, payment of fees) for obtaining a filing date. Guidance: these statutes/regulations provide the legal baseline for the chapter's requirements.
